INSERT INTO messages ( session_id, sender_id, client_message_id, rental_id, text, created_at )
SELECT ms.id, #{userId}, #{clientMessageId}, ms.last_rental_id, #{text}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
FROM message_sessions ms
WHERE ms.id = #{sessionId}
AND ( ms.customer_id = #{userId} OR ms.agent_id = #{userId} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = messages.id
